recognize_zh: 薄層血片中央有一團由許多（約十餘至二十個）紫紅色小顆粒狀裂殖子（merozoites）聚集而成的圓形結構，大小約與一顆紅血球相當，符合間日瘧原蟲（P. vivax）的成熟裂殖體（schizont）；周圍紅血球有乾燥折光假影。
features: Rounded parasite cluster about the size of a red cell containing numerous discrete chromatin dots
Approximately 12-24 merozoites irregularly arranged, favoring P. vivax over P. malariae rosettes
Faint golden-brown pigment and pale host cell outline not well delineated
Background red cells with refractile drying artifact
Neutrophil with ring-shaped nucleus at upper right and small platelet nearby
describe_en: Thin peripheral blood smear shows a mature malarial schizont containing numerous discrete merozoites (approximately 12-24) filling a structure roughly the size of a red cell. The host red cell membrane is poorly delineated in this image, so enlargement and Schüffner stippling cannot be assessed. Background red cells show refractile drying artifact, and a neutrophil and platelets are present. Findings are consistent with a Plasmodium vivax schizont; species confirmation should include host cell size, Schüffner dots, other parasite stages, and PCR or rapid antigen testing if needed.

ddx.vs: P. ovale schizonts usually contain fewer merozoites (6-12) in an enlarged, oval, fimbriated red cell with prominent Schüffner dots.
P. malariae schizonts have 6-12 merozoites arranged in a rosette around central pigment in a normal-sized red cell.
Schizonts of P. falciparum are rarely seen in peripheral blood and are small with 16-24 merozoites in a normal-sized red cell, while P. knowlesi shows up to 16 merozoites with dense pigment.
Platelet clumps show granular purple material with irregular outlines and no discrete merozoite chromatin dots with cytoplasm.
